items.title: Dell Stock Shrugged Off the Nvidia Shipment Pause Reports and Jumped 6.7%
items.summary: Nvidia reportedly told Dell to hold shipments to four Asian countries, yet investors piled in anyway. One price level on Monday will reveal whether the market sees a brief hiccup or a lasting break in the AI buildout.

items.title: Dan Ives Calls Nvidia’s China and Asia Exposure a “Containable 15% to 20%” of Revenue. Huang Faces Congress Next Week
items.summary: Key TakeawaysDan Ives called China and the Southeast Asia loophole a “containable” 15% to 20% of Nvidia’s revenue. Even after losing a fifth of its earnings, Nvidia would trade at about 13x, against a five-year average of 35x.

items.title: Super Micro Computer Fell While Profit Rose
items.summary: If you bought into Super Micro Computer as AI enthusiasm surged and analysts talked up its Data Center Building Block Solutions, you probably expected a smoother ride. items.title: Dell Faces AI Server Shipment Halt as Nvidia Tightens Asia Restrictions
items.summary: New U.S. semiconductor export controls increase regulatory uncertainty for artificial intelligence server manufacturers.

items.title: Supermicro’s $80 Billion Sales Ambition Could Change Its Stock Outlook
items.summary: Supermicro posted a record quarter and raised its outlook, yet shares tumbled anyway. A federal probe now hangs over a stock priced far below its rivals, and one question decides whether the growth ever gets rewarded.

items.title: Jensen Huang Said Blackwell Racks Wouldn't Fit In A 'Pocket Or Backpack' But One Has Reportedly Turned Up in Shanghai
items.summary: Nvidia's GB300 NVL72 rack, containing 72 Blackwell Ultra chips, was installed at a Shanghai data center despite U.S. export restrictions, according to a Bloomberg report.

items.title: Dell, Super Micro Under Pressure as Nvidia Halts Shipments to 4 Asian Countries
items.summary: Server orders bound for four Southeast Asian countries are reportedly stuck, and a new U.S. export rule has a 90-day clock running. Which AI server maker has the room to wait out the delay, and which one does not?
